prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
competitors_mentioned: Texas Dept. of Licensing and Regulation
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single universally “best” HVAC company — the right choice depends on your location in Houston, your budget, whether it’s an emergency, the specific problem, and whether you prefer a national chain or a local company. If you tell me your ZIP code and whether this is urgent, I can give tailored, nearby recommendations and current contact info.

If you want a quick starting point, these firms consistently get strong local reviews in Houston and are worth considering:

- John Moore Services — long-established Houston company, offers 24/7 emergency service and a broad range of HVAC services and maintenance plans.  
- Baker Brothers Plumbing, Air & Electric — well-known locally, good customer service record and fast response times.  
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning / Benjamin Franklin (local franchise operators) — national franchise with on-time guarantees and service windows.  
- ARS/Rescue Rooter — large national provider with many technicians and emergency availability; convenient but sometimes pricier.  

How to pick the best one for your situation
- Verify Texas licensing: look up the contractor on the Texas Dept. of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) or ask for their license number.  
- Check insurance and written warranties/guarantees on repairs and parts.  
- Read recent Google, BBB, and Yelp reviews focused on similar repairs.  
- Get at least two written estimates for non-emergency repairs. Ask for parts, labor, diagnostic fee, and whether a permit is needed.  
- Ask about emergency hours, response time, and flat-fee vs. time-and-materials pricing.  
- For major repairs or older systems, compare repair cost vs. replacement and ask about energy-efficiency rebates.

Typical cost expectations (very rough)
- Minor repairs/diagnostics: $100–$300.  
- Moderate repairs (capacitor, contactor, motor): $300–$800.  
- Major repairs (compressor, coil): $1,000+; sometimes replacement is more cost-effective.

If you want, give me your ZIP code and whether you need same-day service and I’ll pull up the top-rated options near you and their contact info.
